recommendation.text: The GIDAC voted 10 to 0 to support approval (unanimous Yes on all three voting questions: substantial evidence of effectiveness, adequate addressing of cardiovascular risk, and that the risk-benefit profile supports approval).

quote.quote: The application was discussed during a public Gastrointestinal Advisory Committee (GIDAC) meeting on October 18, 2018. The GIDAC voted 10 to 0 to support approval.

linkages.concern: Several committee members raised concern about neuropsychiatric events (including a potential suicidality signal) in patients treated with prucalopride, noting CIC patients' predisposition to conditions such as depression, and recommended adding a label warning describing the relevant neuropsychiatric issues.
linkages.change: FDA added a Warnings and Precautions warning for suicidal ideation and behavior to the MOTEGRITY label.

concern_quote.quote: Several members of the committee expressed concern regarding the neuropsychiatric events that occurred in patients treated with prucalopride. Given the increased predisposition of CIC patients to neuropsychiatric issues such as depression, members of the panel recommended the addition of a warning in the label detailing relevant neuropsychiatric issues.

summary: A public Gastrointestinal Drugs Advisory Committee (GIDAC) meeting was held on October 18, 2018 for NDA 210166 (Motegrity/prucalopride), and the committee voted 10-0 in favor of approval on all three questions (effectiveness, cardiovascular risk adequately addressed, and favorable risk-benefit). The main influence on the approval was the committee's concern about neuropsychiatric/suicidality events: FDA explicitly added a Warnings and Precautions warning for suicidal ideation and behavior to address the concerns raised at the AC meeting. FDA declined the committee's suggestion of a long-term epidemiologic suicidality study, judging that timely product labeling was the more prudent risk-management approach.
